context: November 3 gave continuous positive momentum in all three indices. Buyers are trying to come in, but at this pace they cannot build big quantity, so there is no crowd worth targeting: go with the market.
plan: FLAT TO GAP UP -> BUY, WITH THE MARKET: the buyers hold no big quantity to target; identify buying-side setups.
SMALL GAP DOWN -> BUY: the risk rises, but the same plan stands for now.
